source: A basic wet-kit activation strategy: an arm switch (channel nitrous_arm, default off), a wide-open-throttle switch (min_throttle_command 0.95 [AS: a WOT microswitch closes near full travel]) and an rpm window 3000-6200 rpm [AS: activation well above idle, max below the A25A's 6600 rpm limiter - out/n2o_plan.md 2.5's example]; on/off (no progressive controller). spark_retard_deg 2.0 [C: midpoint of the 1-3 deg the Edelbrock 70011 sheet lists for its 50 hp shot - Edelbrock 'Jet Map Information' for Performer nitrous kits #70011/#70012, Brochure 63-70011 Rev. 07/08, https://static.speedwaymotors.com/pdf/32570011.pdf, as transcribed in out/n2o_plan.md section 9.2 (the sheet itself was not re-read in N2: no download permission in that session)]. Safety cuts: bottle below 55 bar gauge (~800 psig) [AS], fuel starvation [AS], 15 s maximum spray [AS]. Purge solenoid jet 1.0 mm, Cd 0.66 [AS: the kit jet's Cd]. UNVALIDATED until N2O plan N5 (out/n2o_plan.md section 9.2: the whole-kit Edelbrock jet-map check has not run yet).
